description: Defines refresh strategies for each dataset. Specifies how frequently each dataset should be refreshed and the method of triggering a refresh. Configuration only — no scheduler or download logic is implemented.

railway_zones.notes: Railway zones change very rarely. Manual refresh is sufficient.

railway_divisions.notes: Railway divisions change very rarely. Manual refresh is sufficient.

station_codes.notes: Station codes may be added or retired periodically. Monthly refresh is appropriate.

station_master.notes: Station master records may be updated with new stations or metadata changes. Monthly refresh is appropriate.

train_master.notes: Train schedules and train numbers may change with timetable revisions. Monthly refresh is appropriate.

station_categories.notes: Station categories are a stable classification system. Manual refresh is sufficient.

station_status.notes: Station operational status may change due to construction, closures, or reopenings. Weekly refresh is appropriate.

notes: Refresh policy registry. Defines when and how datasets should be refreshed. No scheduler, download logic, or network configuration is included. These policies will be consumed by future refresh phases.
